packs.title: Payment replay
packs.description: Nine repeated paid-job requests must cause one settlement and one execution.

packs.title: Concurrent spending
packs.description: Competing quotes cannot reserve more than the customer budget.

packs.title: Unknown settlement
packs.description: A lost settlement response must retain budget and prevent blind resubmission.

packs.title: Paid service delivery
